project: 0008 Artefacts Foundation (Exports): Persistence + Listing + Fresh Download URLs
overview: Extract the shared artefacts foundation needed by export slices: persist artefacts (storage_key + metadata) and list/download them reliably via fresh signed URLs (refresh-safe), with clear unsafe labelling. This is the canonical F4 (artefacts list) surface reused by 0004 (CSV) and 0005 (Word).
goals: A demo operator can view a matter's exported artefacts and download them successfully.
Download links are refresh-safe: GET /folders/:id/artefacts always returns fresh signed URLs (never persisted).
Unsafe artefacts are clearly labelled via filename + metadata_json + UI tag.
Export slices can reuse one shared artefact persistence contract (schema/template versioning + unsafe metadata) without duplicating logic.
nonGoals: Implementing any specific export formats (CSV in 0004, docx in 0005).
A general-purpose admin UI for artefacts beyond list + download.
successMetrics: For a folder containing artefacts, downloads succeed and remain working after a hard refresh.
No signed URLs are persisted anywhere in Postgres.
Artefacts list UI can be enabled safely behind a feature flag after verification.
openQuestions: Should download_url include expires_at in the API for UI messaging, or keep it opaque for v1?
Should artefacts list be available in all environments, or dev/demo-only for the PoC?

stack.auth: TBD; follow existing folder access rules

routes.name: List Artefacts
routes.purpose: Return artefacts for a folder with fresh signed download_url values (not persisted).

uiNotes: Folder page includes an Artefacts list with filename, kind, created_at, and a Download action.
Unsafe artefacts are visibly labelled UNSAFE (tag + filename contains .UNSAFE.).
Artefacts list UI is feature-flagged off by default until verified end-to-end.
rules: Signed download URLs are generated at read time and are never persisted in Postgres.
List endpoint must be refresh-safe: repeated calls return working download URLs even if previous URLs expired.
List endpoint must be no-store/no-cache (download_url values are per-request).
Unsafe artefacts must be clearly labelled: filename contains .UNSAFE. and metadata_json.unsafe_override=true (when applicable).

inScope: Storage integration: upload bytes using stable storage_key; generate fresh signed download URLs at read time.
API: GET /folders/:id/artefacts returns artefacts sorted newest-first with fresh download_url values; errors use safe envelope (ADR-0008).
UI: Artefacts list in folder UI with download actions and UNSAFE labelling.
Logging/metrics: list calls + signed URL generation outcomes include folder_id + trace_id.
Rollback/disable: feature-flag artefacts list UI off by default.
outOfScope: Any endpoint that allows arbitrary file upload to create artefacts (exports create artefacts).

risks: Signed URL TTL too short (operator clicks an expired link mid-demo).
Caching layers accidentally cache download_url values (must be no-store).
Storage provider differences (local vs cloud) create inconsistent download behaviour.
verificationPlan: Unit/integration tests for GET /folders/:id/artefacts response shape, sorting, and safe error handling.
Test that download_url is computed per-call (varies between calls) and is not stored in the DB.
Manual smoke in dev: create a folder with at least one artefact (via an export slice once available or via a dev seed path) and confirm list + downloads work, then refresh and re-download.

stories.title: List Artefacts With Fresh Signed URLs
stories.description: As a demo operator, I can view a folder's exported artefacts and download them reliably so I can retrieve outputs during demos.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: GET /folders/:id/artefacts returns artefacts for the folder, sorted newest-first, and includes a working fresh download_url for each artefact.
Example: Repeating the list call after a refresh returns new download_url values and downloads still succeed.
Negative: Signed URLs are not persisted in Postgres; only storage_key + metadata are stored.
Negative: Responses are marked no-store/no-cache to avoid caching download_url values.

stories.title: Render Artefacts List In Folder UI
stories.description: As a demo operator, I can see an Artefacts list in the folder UI and download each artefact so I can access outputs without leaving the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Folder UI shows an Artefacts list (filename, kind, created_at) and a Download action that uses the latest download_url.
Example: Unsafe artefacts are visibly labelled UNSAFE (UI tag + filename contains .UNSAFE.).
Negative: When the feature flag is off, the Artefacts list UI is hidden/disabled (safe default).
Negative: The UI does not display raw storage_key values.
